{{pagebanner|Ebisu_Banner.jpg}}
'''Ebisu''' (恵比寿, archaically also ''Yebisu'') is the southernmost district of [[Tokyo/Shibuya|Shibuya]] ward, in [[Tokyo]], [[Japan]].

==Get in==
{{Mapframe|35.646643|139.710045|zoom=14}}
{{Mapshape}}
{{Mapshapes|Q682894}} <!-- Tokyo Metro -->
{{Mapshapes|Q247782}} <!-- Toei Subway -->
{{Mapshape|wikidata=Q225095|type=geoline|stroke=#00b48d|stroke-width=4|stroke-opacity=1}} <!-- Rinkai Line -->

Ebisu is a station on the JR Yamanote line, one stop south of [[Tokyo/Shibuya|Shibuya]].  The Metro Hibiya subway line from [[Tokyo/Roppongi|Roppongi]] also stops in Ebisu.
The Saikyo line and the Shonan-Shinjuku Line also stop in JR Ebisu station.

==Get around==
Ebisu is compact enough to cover on foot.  A convenient '''moving walkway''' connects to the popular Ebisu Garden Place.
Daikanyama, Nakameguro, Hiroo and Shibuya are close to Ebisu. You can walk to those places easily.

==See==
The neighborhood immediately outside of the metro station has dozens of restaurants and several fun bars. Ebisu offers nightlife without the sleaziness of Shinjuku or Roppongi. Another attraction is the '''[https://gardenplace.jp/ Yebisu Garden Place]''', a new "city in a city" developed on the site of a former brewery. Access is via the JR station's Garden Place exit, which leads to a moving walkway leading into the district.

| name=Tokyo Metropolitan Museum of Photography | alt=東京都写真美術館, Tokyo-to Shashin Bijutsukan | url=http://topmuseum.jp/ | email=
| address=in Yebisu Garden Place | lat=35.6417 | long=139.7132 | directions=
| phone=+81 3-3280-0099 | tollfree=
| hours= | price=Entrance fees depend on the exhibits you wish to visit but there are often some free ones
| image=Tokyo Metropolitan Museum of Photography entrance 2011 January.jpg | wikidata=Q862884
| lastedit=2022-12-12
| content=A must for fans of photography, with multiple floors of constantly changing exhibitions of the best photography from around Japan and the world.
}}
* {{see
| name=Yebisu Brewery Tokyo | alt=former Beer Museum | url=https://www.sapporobeer.jp/brewery/y_museum/ | email=
| address=in Yebisu Garden Place | lat=35.643088 | long=139.714541 | directions=
| phone= | tollfree=
| hours=Tu-Su 10:00-18:00 | price=Entry is free, and you can sample 6 types of beer for &yen;400 each if so inclined. Alternatively there are guided tours in Japanese which include two beers and cost &yen;500
| lastedit=2022-12-12
| content=A mildly interesting permanent exhibition covering the brewing process in general and the history of Japan Beer Brewery Company which developed Yebisu beer, and which is now a part of Sapporo Breweries. There is even a Virtual Brewery Adventure to try.
}}

==Eat==
Ebisu has a good selection of places to eat, mostly slightly upmarket. The Garden Place also has a large number of restaurants.

==Drink==
Ebisu is also a trendy nightlife district, with many slightly quirky bars and clubs.

| phone=+81 3-3496-7744 | tollfree=
| hours=17:00-03:00 | price=
| content=A small standing bar with many high quality varieties of sake available in cup-size bottles: great for tasting several from all over Japan. All sake is initially served cold, but the staff will warm each cup to your desired temperature.
